Press B to return to the title.

Static captures are always exempt
from ordinary area limits.

KO, fleeing and failed catches
also consume opportunities.

This choice is inactive while
its parent rule is OFF.

This Pokemon cannot recover
or be used again.

Egg production is suspended
during the Day Care quarantine.

Run data could not be initialized.
No save data was overwritten.

Field HMs need their disc/badge.
A living helper prevents softlocks.

BST Range sets the eligible pool.
BST Similarity sets the preference.

Up/Down: review  B: edit settings
Last row: A to begin this run

Choose a preset with Left/Right
or A. It resets the rule choices.
Change any setting afterward to
create a Custom profile.
The resolved seed stays the same.

Replaces ordinary wild species
with seeded choices. Grass, caves,
surfing, fishing and other normal
methods use BST Range and
BST Similarity. Levels stay native.

Replaces opposing trainer species
using the seed and team slot.
Party size and held items stay
native. Changed species receive
valid level-up moves.

Controls how much stronger or
weaker a replacement Pokemon
can be, using its total base stats.
BST does not depend on level.
Example: BST 400 at 25% allows
replacement BSTs from 300 to 500.

Controls how likely similar BST
values are chosen from the pool.
0%: equal candidate chances.
25%: slight preference.
50%: moderate preference.
75%: strong preference.
100%: very strong preference.
Every eligible species can occur.

Separates ordinary Pokemon from
legendary and mythical Pokemon.
Legendary restrictions apply before
BST weighting and any fallback.

Randomizes eligible scripted
static species. Static capture
exemptions remain mandatory.
Roamers keep their stored species
and native story bookkeeping.

Randomizes scripted gift Pokemon,
including the three starters.
Starter previews and the granted
Pokemon use the same mapping.
Trades retain their native species.

Randomizes scripted gift Egg
species. Hatching spends no new
area opportunity. Breeding Eggs
retain their parent-derived species.

Randomizes ordinary visible and
hidden overworld pickups.
Important story items, Key Items,
HMs, TMs, fossils and orbs stay
native. NPC gifts, shops and held
items are unaffected. Quantities
and pickup flags are preserved.

Automatic creates a seed when
the run is configured. Manual lets
you edit its eight hexadecimal
digits on the Seed row. The resolved
seed is stored with the run.

The same seed, rules and data
produce the same replacements.
Ordinary battle RNG cannot change
them. A edits digits in settings;
A accepts editing and B undoes it.

Each eligible encounter reserves
one opportunity immediately.
Catching, defeating or fleeing
all spend it. With 2 or 3 chances,
repeat species do not reserve
another chance in the same area.
OFF disables area capture limits.

Previously owned evolutionary
families are duplicates, including
branching evolutions and Pokemon
that died or were released.
Duplicates spend no ordinary
chance and cannot be caught.

Shiny wild Pokemon may be caught
as bonus encounters despite dupes
or an exhausted area. They spend
no ordinary chance. This does not
change how often shinies appear.

Changes how often newly generated
Pokemon are shiny. A smaller
denominator means more shinies.
Existing Pokemon never change.
Shiny Clause is a separate rule.
Forced shinies and special Egg
restrictions retain native behavior.

Gift Pokemon have their own event
record and spend no area chance.
OFF makes an eligible gift share
the ordinary area allowance.

Gift Eggs have their own event
record and spend no area chance.
OFF shares the area allowance.
Hatching never spends a chance.

A fainted owned Pokemon becomes
permanently exhausted. Healing,
Revives and PC storage cannot
restore it. Its history remains
available in the Memorial.

With permadeath, losing every
usable party Pokemon ends the run,
even with living PC reserves.
This rule follows Permadeath and
cannot be disabled separately.

ON permits native breeding Eggs.
OFF quarantines Egg production
and collection during this run.
Gift Eggs remain a separate system.

Uses the next unscaled boss ace
plus your allowance, at most 100.
Trainer scaling never raises it.
The chosen Level Cap Mode controls
EXP or battle-entry enforcement.
After eight badges: Cynthia.

Adds this many levels to the
normal cap. It never raises a cap
above level 100. Inactive when
Level Cap is OFF.

Adds levels to opposing trainer
Pokemon based on earned badges.
Wild levels remain unchanged.
Link and facility battles keep
their native parties.

Additional trainer levels equal
badges times Levels per badge.
Levels cannot exceed 100.
Inactive when Trainer scaling
is OFF.

Includes leaders, rivals and
other classified strong trainers
in badge-based scaling.
OFF keeps their native levels.
Inactive when scaling is OFF.

Shows remaining capture chances
after the native area-name popup.
Repeated floors of one logical
area do not repeat the notice.
Tracking works even when this
notification is disabled.

Review all selected values before
starting. B returns to editing.
At the final Confirm and begin
entry, A locks the rules and
starts the Rowan introduction.

Inspect the complete saved rules.
They are locked during a run.
Start a New Game to choose
different rules and a new seed.

Shows ordinary opportunities in
your current logical capture area.
A on View area attempts opens
the individual species and results.
Static and shiny bonus captures
are tracked separately.

Capture tracking not yet active.
It activates when you first obtain
a usable Poke Ball from any source,
including a shop or a field pickup.
Once active, it stays active even
when no Balls remain.

Area capture restrictions are OFF.
Wild encounters do not consume
ordinary capture opportunities.
Other enabled run systems remain
independent of this setting.

Current badges, level cap, next
cap target, trainer bonus and run
status. Progress is read from the
native save and persistent run.

Counts eligible ordinary capture
zones and their remaining chances.
Caught and failed results come
from persistent opportunity slots.
Statics and shiny bonus captures
have separate counters.

Review every known capture zone.
Current area comes first, then
visited available areas, visited
exhausted areas and other areas.
A opens the three attempt slots.

Owned Pokemon remain linked
through renaming, evolution and
PC moves. A shows original species,
origin, status and evolution history.

Review permanently exhausted
Pokemon and their nicknames,
original capture locations,
evolutions and defeat locations.
A opens the detailed history.

Separate records for statics,
legendary statics, gift Pokemon,
gift Eggs and bonus shiny catches.
A opens a category, then an event.
Repeatable events keep counters.

This saved run uses the original
linear BST preference. Its mapping
is preserved when loading this ROM.
New runs use a Gaussian mixture
for BST Similarity instead.

Choose EXP Lock or Obedience Cap.
EXP Lock is the default. This choice
is ignored when Level Cap is OFF.

Pokemon gain EXP normally.
Above the cap, they refuse entry
and switching into battle.
At the cap they remain eligible.
An active Pokemon that levels up
may finish the current battle.
If none can fight, your run ends,
even with living PC reserves.

EXP stops at the effective cap.
A capped Pokemon receives 0 EXP.
Excess EXP is discarded per Pokemon.
Others keep their normal shares.
Lost EXP is never redistributed.
Rare Candies and Day Care obey
the same cap.

Eligible party Pokemon are alive,
not Eggs and not exhausted.
In Obedience Cap mode, their level
must also be at or below the cap.
Overleveled Pokemon are not dead
and may still be stored or follow.

Only one eligible Pokemon remains!
If none can fight after a battle,
your run ends, even with living
Pokemon in PC storage.
Overleveled Pokemon are not dead.
A later badge can make them
eligible again while the run is active.

This run ended because the party
had no eligible combatants.
Living overleveled Pokemon were
not marked dead or deleted.
Living PC reserves cannot prevent
this mandatory loss condition.

This Pokemon refuses to battle!
Its level exceeds your current cap.

Original postgame event encounter.
Professor Oak in Eterna gives the
Key Items once prerequisites are met.
Statics ignore ordinary limits and
dupes. Failed attempts retain native
retry behavior and reuse one record.
